note: Ludovico→Giovanni Lochner, Mantua: reads letters daily with spectacles; asks more pairs. ASMA Copialettere B.2886. Quoted Ilardi 2007; first Signorini Opus hoc tenue.
Abbot Bessarion (S. Benedetto Polirone)→Ludovico: sends 2 pairs; recalls his sight failing and need to start using ochialli. Luzio-Renier print full text.
Barbara→Federico: bring ochiali assai (may include gifts). ASMA. Corroborates court supply; not Ludovico self-activity.
Ludovico→Zaccaria Saggi: still wears glasses (ochiali pesano) — continued near-work reading at +13y after 1460 onset.
